The '''Ministry of Sentinel Affairs''' is one of the governing bodies of [[Huanglong]]. A special agency responsible for monitoring Sentinels, astronomy, and calendars across Huanglong's various cities. Led by the Minister of Sentinel Affairs in [[Mingting]], it has subordinate bureaus in the other six cities, each headed by a Supervisor. While they hold independent authority on Sentinel-related matters, they are limited to advising and supervising the administrative bodies of each city and Mingting.
